name: Hesychast controversy resolved
summary: Councils held in Constantinople (June and August 1341) endorse Gregory Palamas's defence of hesychasm, the contemplative-prayer practice centred on Mount Athos, against the Italian-Calabrian humanist Barlaam. Further councils in 1347 and 1351 confirm Palamite theology.

_quarry.structural_significance: Definitive theological foundation of late-Byzantine Orthodoxy; the Palamite essence-energies distinction remains a hallmark of Orthodox theology distinguishing it from scholastic Latin approaches.
